title: ot-work-order/v1
description: A signed synthetic work order (runner.work_order). It names one building, asset, parameter and operation, the permitted value range, a validity window and the APS delegation it is bound to. The signature is Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 JCS form of every other member, by a TEST-ONLY key. Contract: docs/federation/authority-fixture-contract.md. Status: proposed in issue #27.

value_range.description: Inclusive on both ends. The value range is the work order's alone; the delegation scope has none.

delegation_id.description: The APS delegation's identifier, as APS states it.

delegation_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the RFC 8785 JCS form of the complete signed delegation.

issuer.description: Id of the test-only signing key; its raw Ed25519 public key (base64url) ships with the fixture set.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding, over JCS(work order without signature).
